name: Irojikake Quest ~Inma Yuwaku to Roraku~
original_name: 色仕掛けクエスト～淫魔誘惑と籠絡～
source:
The protagonist, the Fire Dragon Hero, sets out on a journey to defeat the Demon King with his childhood sweetheart Finne and his best friend Gard. 
Along the way, succubi tempt him in all sorts of ways , leading to betrayal and infidelity , the breakdown of friendships between the group, and the collapse of the protagonist's own army. 

The story depicts everything from the setup leading up to the temptation to the ending after succumbing to temptation.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax-touch/work/=/product_id/RJ01466404.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
主人公火龙勇者与青梅竹马芬妮、好友加尔德一起踏上了讨伐魔王的旅程。
一路上，魅魔以各种方式诱惑他，导致他的背叛和不忠、团体之间友谊的破裂以及主角自己军队的崩溃。

故事讲述了从诱惑前的准备到屈服于诱惑后的结局。

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax-touch/work/=/product_id/RJ01466404.html]DLsite[/url]]
